title: Tencent Releases Second Quarter Report: Dual Breakthroughs in Models and AI Products, Continued Heavy Investment in AI
excerpt: On August 12, Tencent Holdings (00700.HK) released its second-quarter report: Hy3 of the Hunyuan series completed a rapid iteration from preview to the official
content_html:
On August 12, Tencent Holdings (00700.HK) released its second-quarter report: Hy3 of the Hunyuan series completed a rapid iteration from preview to the official version, with the number of calls exceeding 68 times that of the previous generation model within one week of its launch; a larger parameter version, Hy4, is also planned for release in the near future; WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy continue to lead the domestic AI-native intelligent agent market, with data from Analysys showing that WorkBuddy's PC end traffic exceeded 20 million visits in June; the WeChat AI assistant "Xiaowei" is currently in a gradual testing phase.

In the second quarter, Tencent's gaming revenue increased by 11%, with local gaming revenue growing by 17% and international gaming revenue increasing by 4% on a fixed exchange rate basis; marketing services revenue increased by 22%; financial technology and enterprise services revenue increased by 9%, with cloud services benefiting from AI-driven growth, expansion of international operations, and increased demand for general cloud services.

content_html_zh:
8月12日，腾讯控股（00700.HK）发布二季度报告：混元系列Hy3完成从预览版到正式版的快速迭代，上市一周内通话次数超过上一代机型68倍；更大参数的版本Hy4也计划在不久的将来发布； WorkBuddy和CodeBuddy继续领跑国内AI原生智能座席市场，易观数据显示，6月份WorkBuddy PC端访问量突破2000万次；微信AI助手“小微”目前正处于逐步测试阶段。

第二季度，腾讯游戏收入增长11%，按固定汇率计算，本地游戏收入增长17%，国际游戏收入增长4%；营销服务收入增长22%；金融科技和企业服务收入增长9%，云服务受益于人工智能驱动的增长、国际业务的扩张以及通用云服务需求的增加。
